title: People’s Mañanera September 4
author: Pedro Gellert
content:
_Every day, President Claudia Sheinbaum gives a morning presidential press
conference and Mexico Solidarity Media posts English language summaries,
translated by Mexico Solidarity’s Pedro Gellert. Previous press conference
summaries are available[here](https://mexicosolidarity.com/mananera/)._

**Transformation Begins at the Local Level  
** Speaking from Zacatecas, President Claudia Sheinbaum highlighted progress
in security and well-being in rural areas: “I want to congratulate the
governor’s team for its work on security,” she said. The Fourth Transformation
(4T) strengthens peace, production, and well-being at the local level.

**Coordination, Intelligence, and Dignity to Build Peace  
** In Zacatecas, intentional homicides declined by 85% between September 2024
and August 2026, and by 96% compared to 2021. In addition, the monthly salary
for police officers has risen from 3,500 to 18,000 pesos (US$206 to US$1,064)
since 2021. The President emphasized that “when there is coordination,
commitment, determination, and follow-up from the governor, the situation
changes significantly.”

**Toward the Transformation of the Mexican Countryside  
** The Well-Being Programs reach 13 million producers, involving 107 billion
pesos (US$6.33 billion) in funding. Mexico has more than 27,000 Well-Being
Stores—the largest supply network in Latin America—and is self-sufficient in
white corn.

**More Investment and Domestic Production Strengthen Mexico  
** Investment grew 7.7% year-over-year in June. In addition, record exports to
the United States have been recorded, driven by electronic components.
Sheinbaum emphasized that, despite negative forecasts, “the movement we come
from is doing very well.”

**Water for the People and Agricultural Sovereignty  
** Sheinbaum declared that water for Zacatecas will be guaranteed. Dialogue is
ongoing to build the Milpillas Dam, and if no agreement is reached,
alternatives will be sought. Furthermore, support programs, guaranteed prices,
and improvements to bean seeds will continue.
